unified_features.name: Accounts and sign-in
unified_features.rationale: A and B both sign users in with email and password; A's server session in an http-only cookie is the safer of the two. B's JWT (M02) is dropped: one session mechanism for the app.
unified_features.behaviour: A user signs in with email and password and gets an http-only, secure, same-site cookie session with an expiry; logout ends it; a failed sign-in returns one generic error.
unified_features.improvements: Add a password hash column with a slow hash (A has no password column), session expiry, logout, and a failure branch on sign-in.

unified_features.name: Post authoring
unified_features.rationale: Both apps let a user write a post; one create-post with one author rule, one length limit and one starting status avoids two posting paths.
unified_features.behaviour: A signed-in member writes a post; the author is the session user; the body must be 1 to N characters where N is the single limit decided at compatibility; every new post starts as pending.
unified_features.improvements: Validate length in the handler (A relied on the database alone; B raised an unhandled ValueError) and return a 422 error in the app's error shape.

unified_features.name: Pre-moderation
unified_features.rationale: Pre-moderation (A) and instant publishing (B) cannot coexist; pre-moderation is kept and instant publishing (M06) dropped.
unified_features.behaviour: Moderators see pending posts oldest first and publish or reject each one; only pending posts can be decided; who decided and when is recorded.
unified_features.improvements: Accept only published or rejected as a decision (A did not validate it); record moderator and time.

unified_features.name: Reading a post
unified_features.rationale: A reads members-only and leaks pending posts to every member; B reads publicly. One read rule combines B's public reading with A's moderation status.
unified_features.behaviour: Read access follows the single rule decided at compatibility (recommended: published posts readable by anyone; pending and rejected posts only by their author and moderators; otherwise 404).
unified_features.improvements: Status-aware visibility check in one authorisation function.

unified_features.name: Post list
unified_features.rationale: Both apps have a /posts screen and neither has a list endpoint; one list is rebuilt.
unified_features.behaviour: The /posts screen lists published posts newest first with cursor pagination, under the same read rule as U04.
unified_features.improvements: A list endpoint is new: neither source has one.
